name: Sheraton Mall of the Emirates Hotel, Dubai
insider_take: The only hotel in the world where you can ski in the morning and shop luxury brands in the afternoon—all without stepping outside.
whats_special: This architectural marvel is built directly into the Mall of the Emirates, home to the Middle East's first indoor ski resort, Ski Dubai. With temperatures reaching -4°C inside the snow park, you can literally go from desert heat to alpine conditions in minutes. The hotel's unique position offers direct access to over 630 stores and the iconic 85-meter ski slope with real snow penguins.
pro_tip: Book a room on floors 8-12 for stunning views of the indoor ski slope through floor-to-ceiling windows—you can watch skiers and snowboarders while sipping your morning coffee in 40°C Dubai heat.
dont_miss: The surreal experience of dining at Après, the slope-side restaurant where you can enjoy hot chocolate while watching people ski indoors in the desert. Also, catch the daily penguin encounters at Ski Dubai—these sub-Antarctic Gentoo and King penguins are a rare sight in the Middle East.
pros: Direct connection to Mall of the Emirates with world-class shopping and dining
Adjacent to Ski Dubai indoor ski resort for unique entertainment
Strategic location near Dubai Marina and Jumeirah Beach
Modern amenities with rooftop pool and multiple dining venues
cons: Shopping mall location may feel busy for those seeking tranquility
Distance from Dubai's historic districts and traditional attractions
